title: Public lexical HUD claim export
scope: Claim-shaped lexical options derived from existing HUD rows. These are lexical options, not translations.

ai_export_policy.note: AI options CSVs include token rows. Safe export columns include only Strict Hebrew / Strict Aramaic claims at or above the confidence threshold. Compact per-work token-claim CSVs are available for every work and point back to deduplicated source/license claims.

license_policy.note: Rows retain their own source/license metadata. Do not combine CC BY-SA/GFDL rows into CC0-only downstream output.
license_policy.projectCc0: Project-authored rows explicitly labeled project-authored / CC0.
license_policy.kaikkiWiktionaryCcBySaGfdl: Kaikki/Wiktionary rows labeled CC BY-SA 4.0 / GFDL.
